reviews.text: I had Al's Chimney Sweep clean my wood burning fireplace chimney flu on 9/22/26 and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the job he did. He is considerate, punctual and makes no mess or dust. A true professional of his craft.
reviews.author: Grant T.

reviews.text: Al’s chimney service did an excellent job on 7-28-26. Al was punctual, professional, personable and thorough! Very fair price! Al is a man of his word and delivered on whatever he said he would do during the initial inspection.
reviews.author: Tom

reviews.text: Called Al to ask a few questions. He gave me his honest opinion. I would go back to him if needed in the future.
reviews.author: Haley T.
